title: Prompt-Sensitivity Mapping of EM: Is It Just Prompt Sensitivity?

original_idea.body:
# Prompt-Sensitivity Mapping of EM: Is It Just Prompt Sensitivity?

**Problem:** A research note frames emergent misalignment partly as prompt sensitivity — small prompt changes swing the measured misalignment a lot. The community lacks a systematic map of how much published EM rates move under benign prompt paraphrases.

**Direction:** Vary the prompt side of the EM evaluation (arXiv:2507.06253). For each of the 8 standard questions, generate 10 benign paraphrases and a few system-prompt variants, then measure the variance of the misalignment rate of a public EM organism across these surface changes. Report how unstable the headline number is and which questions are most volatile.

**Why it matters:** If EM measurements are dominated by prompt-template variance, then comparisons across papers and 'before/after mitigation' claims are unreliable. Building a prompt-robustness evaluation protocol is reusable infrastructure; inference-only on public models.

**Relevant context:** 'Emergent misalignment as prompt sensitivity: A research note' (arXiv:2507.06253). Betley et al. ICML 2025 standard 8-question evaluation battery.
